column1: Undersea turbines which produce electricity from the tides are set to become an important source of renewable energy for Britain.
column2: 利用潮汐发电的海底涡轮机有望成为英国重要的可再生能源来源。

column1: It is still too early to predict the extent of the impact they may have, but all the signs are that they will play a significant role in the future
column2: 现在预测这些涡轮机可能产生多大影响还为时过早，但种种迹象都表明，它们将在未来发挥重要作用。
column9: play a significant role|发挥重要作用

column1: Operating on the same principle as wind turbines, the power in sea turbines comes from tidal currents which turn blades similar to ships’ propellers, but, unlike wind, the tides are predictable and the power input is constant.
column2: 海底涡轮机与风力涡轮机的工作原理相同。它的动力来自潮流，流动的海水带动形似船舶螺旋桨的叶片旋转。不过，潮汐与风不同，可以预测，而且输入功率稳定。

column1: The technology raises the prospect of Britain becoming self-sufficient in renewable energy and drastically reducing its carbon dioxide emissions.
column2: 这项技术使英国有望实现可再生能源自给，并大幅减少二氧化碳排放。
column3: raises the prospect of|使……有望实现
column8: carbon dioxide emissions|二氧化碳排放

column1: If tide, wind and wave power are all developed, Britain would be able to close gas, coal and nuclear power plants and export renewable power to other parts of Europe.
column2: 如果潮汐能、风能和波浪能都得到开发，英国就能关闭燃气、燃煤和核能发电厂，并向欧洲其他地区出口用可再生能源生产的电力。
column7: would be able to|届时就能
column13: renewable power|用可再生能源生产的电力

column1: Unlike wind power, which Britain originally developed and then abandoned for 20 years allowing the Dutch to make it a major industry, undersea turbines could become a big export earner to island nations such as Japan and New Zealand.
column2: 风能原本由英国开发，英国后来却将其搁置了二十年，荷兰人由此得以将风能发展为一大产业。海底涡轮机则可能成为英国面向日本、新西兰等岛国的出口创汇大项。

column1: Tidal sites have already been identified that will produce one sixth or more of the UK’s power - and at prices competitive with modern gas turbines and undercutting those of the already ailing nuclear industry.
column2: 已经确定了一些潮汐发电场址，这些场址将能提供英国六分之一或更多的电力。其电价足以与现代燃气轮机发电的价格竞争，且低于本已不景气的核电行业的电价。

column1: One site alone, the Pentland Firth, between Orkney and mainland Scotland, could produce 10% of the country’s electricity with banks of turbines under the sea, and another at Alderney in the Channel Islands three times the 1,200 megawatts of Britain’s largest and newest nuclear plant, Sizewell B, in Suffolk.
column2: 仅奥克尼群岛与苏格兰本土之间的彭特兰海峡这一处，成排的海底涡轮机就可提供全国10%的电力。海峡群岛奥尔德尼岛的另一处场址，则可提供相当于萨福克郡塞兹韦尔B核电站三倍的发电功率。后者是英国最大、最新的核电站，功率为1200兆瓦。

column1: Other sites identified include the Bristol Channel and the west coast of Scotland, particularly the channel between Campbeltown and Northern Ireland.
column2: 其他已经确定的场址包括布里斯托尔海峡和苏格兰西海岸，尤其是坎贝尔敦与北爱尔兰之间的海峡。

column1: Work on designs for the new turbine blades and sites are well advanced at the University of Southampton’s sustainable energy research group.
column2: 南安普敦大学可持续能源研究小组对新型涡轮叶片和场址的设计工作已取得很大进展。

column1: The first station is expected to be installed off Lynmouth in Devon shortly to test the technology in a venture jointly funded by the department of Trade and Industry and the European Union.
column2: 首座电站预计不久就会安装在德文郡林茅斯近海，用以测试这项技术。这一项目由英国贸易与工业部和欧盟共同出资。

column1: AbuBakr Bahaj, in charge of the Southampton research, said: ‘The prospects for energy from tidal currents are far better than from wind because the flows of water are predictable and constant.
column2: 负责南安普敦这项研究的阿布巴克尔·巴哈吉说：“潮流发电的前景远胜风力发电，因为水流既可预测又稳定。

column1: The technology for dealing with the hostile saline environment under the sea has been developed in the North Sea oil industry and much is already known about turbine blade design, because of wind power and ship propellers.
column2: 北海石油工业已经开发出应对海底恶劣盐水环境的技术；借助风力发电和船舶螺旋桨方面的经验，人们对涡轮叶片的设计也已有了相当多的了解。
column10: turbine blade design|涡轮叶片设计

column1: There are a few technical difficulties, but I believe in the next five to ten years we will be installing commercial marine turbine farms.’
column2: 还有几个技术难题，但我相信，在未来五至十年内，我们就会着手建设商业海洋涡轮发电场。”
column8: marine turbine farms|海洋涡轮发电场

column1: Southampton has been awarded £215,000 over three years to develop the turbines and is working with Marine Current Turbines, a subsidiary of IT power, on the Lynmouth project.
column2: 南安普敦大学获得了一笔为期三年、总额21.5万英镑的资助，用于研发涡轮机；该校正与IT Power旗下的海流涡轮机公司合作，开发林茅斯项目。

column1: EU research has now identified 106 potential sites for tidal power, 80% round the coasts of Britain.
column2: 欧盟的研究迄今已确定106个潜在的潮汐发电场址，其中80%位于英国沿海。

column1: The best sites are between islands or around heavily indented coasts where there are strong tidal currents.
column2: 最佳场址位于岛屿之间，或在海岸线曲折、潮流强劲的沿海地带。

column1: A marine turbine blade needs to be only one third of the size of a wind generator to produce three times as much power.
column2: 海洋涡轮机的叶片只需有风力发电机三分之一的大小，就能产生三倍的功率。
column3: marine turbine blade|海洋涡轮机叶片
column9: three times as much|三倍之多

column1: The blades will be about 20 metres in diameter, so around 30 metres of water is required.
column2: 叶片旋转时的直径约为20米，因此所需水深约为30米。

column1: Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.
column2: 与风力发电不同，潮汐发电不太可能遭到环保方面的反对。

column1: Fish and other creatures are thought unlikely to be at risk from the relatively slow-turning blades.
column2: 人们认为，这些转动相对缓慢的叶片不太可能危及鱼类和其他生物。

column1: Each turbine will be mounted on a tower which will connect to the national power supply grid via underwater cables.
column2: 每台涡轮机都将安装在一座塔架上，塔架将经由水下电缆与国家电网相连。
column7: national power supply grid|国家电网

column1: The towers will stick out of the water and be lit, to warn shipping, and also be designed to be lifted out of the water for maintenance and to clean seaweed from the blades.
column2: 这些塔架将伸出水面，并点灯警示过往船只；设计上还可将塔架提出水面，以便进行维护，清除叶片上的海藻。

column1: Dr Bahaj has done most work on the Alderney site, where there are powerful currents.
column2: 巴哈吉博士研究得最多的是奥尔德尼岛的场址，那里的海流很强。

column1: The single undersea turbine farm would produce far more power than needed for the Channel Islands and most would be fed into the French Grid and be re-imported into Britain via the cable under the Channel.
column2: 单是这一处海底涡轮发电场，发电量就会远超海峡群岛所需；其中大部分电力将输入法国电网，然后经英吉利海峡底部的电缆重新输入英国。
column4: undersea turbine farm|海底涡轮发电场

column1: One technical difficulty is cavitation, where low pressure behind a turning blade causes air bubbles.
column2: 一个技术难题是空化：旋转叶片背后的压力较低，会形成气泡。

column1: These can cause vibration and damage the blades of the turbines.
column2: 这些气泡可能引起振动，损坏涡轮机的叶片。

column1: Dr Bahaj said: ‘We have to test a number of blade types to avoid this happening or at least make sure it does not damage the turbines or reduce performance.
column2: 巴哈吉博士说：“我们得试验多种类型的叶片，以免发生这种情况；至少也要确保这种现象不会损坏涡轮机或降低其性能。

column1: Another slight concern is submerged debris floating into the blades.
column2: 另一个小小的顾虑是，水下漂浮的杂物可能漂进叶片之间。

column1: So far we do not know how much of a problem it might be.
column2: 目前我们还不知道这可能会带来多大的问题。
column4: how much of a problem|问题有多大

column1: We will have to make the turbines robust because the sea is a hostile environment, but all the signs that we can do it are good.’
column2: 我们得把涡轮机造得足够坚固，因为海洋环境很恶劣。不过，目前的种种迹象都表明，我们有望做到这一点。”
